criteria.text: At an explicit research level WebResearchService adds Wikipedia/Wikidata sources through constrained fetch with a citable extract; a level-less call does not touch the lane; a failing lane leaves the provider answer intact.
ResearchQuotaService counts in Redis per organization, level and UTC month with the unchanged limits 20/10/3; a Redis failure falls back to memory with a warning; no Prisma schema change.
The review-tail worktree and merged branch are removed; specification, handoff and runbook describe the live lane and durable quota; open owner items are listed, not absorbed.
Local acceptance passes (three-app tsc, build, full suite receipt, process verification, empty migrate diff) and the wave is released by the runbook with rollback 92f0b95dfe3f and a release record.
